expectations.text: 应用入口安装 @mpxjs/api-proxy，并通过 mpx.use(apiProxy, { usePromise: true }) 明确启用 Promise 风格
expectations.evidence: outputs/src/app.mpx imports apiProxy from '@mpxjs/api-proxy' and calls mpx.use(apiProxy, { usePromise: true }) before mpx.createApp.

expectations.text: Web 输出中的普通趋势词请求通过会返回 Promise 的 Mpx 官方 API 调用路径使用 await 或 Promise 链；可使用配置后的 mpx.request 或会被跨端编译转换到该入口的 wx.request。原始 @mpxjs/api-proxy 命名导入不会继承 Promise 化配置，不能直接按 Promise 使用；不得混用 success/fail 回调
expectations.evidence: outputs/src/services/search.js fetchTrendingKeywords uses mpx.request({ url: '/api/search/trending' }).then(({ data }) => data) with no success/fail callbacks and no raw @mpxjs/api-proxy named import.

expectations.text: 联想词请求保存可取消任务：可通过单次 usePromise: false 或原始 @mpxjs/api-proxy 命名导入直接取得 RequestTask，也可从已 Promise 化调用的 Promise.__returned 取得框架保留的原始任务；连续搜索与卸载会先废弃当前任务身份再 abort 旧任务
expectations.evidence: outputs/src/pages/search/index.mpx search() calls cancelSuggestionRequest() before starting a new suggestion request, obtains the cancellable task via const task = requestPromise.__returned, stores it in this.requestTask, and onUnload() calls cancelSuggestionRequest(); cancelSuggestionRequest() sets this.requestTask = null and increments requestGeneration before aborting the old task.

expectations.text: 联想词 success/fail 回调捕获本次任务和关键词，仅当前任务且关键词仍匹配时才更新结果或提示，旧响应不能覆盖新搜索
expectations.evidence: outputs/src/pages/search/index.mpx requestPromise.then success and failure handlers close over task, generation, and keyword, then call isCurrentSuggestionRequest(task, generation, keyword) before updating suggestions or showing the toast; isCurrentSuggestionRequest verifies this.requestTask === task, this.requestGeneration === generation, and this.keyword === keyword.

expectations.text: 详情跳转与错误提示继续走 Mpx 官方 API 链路；可保留会被跨端编译转换的 wx.navigateTo/wx.showToast，可沿用 mpx.xxx，也可在不依赖应用级配置时使用 @mpxjs/api-proxy 命名导入
expectations.evidence: outputs/src/pages/search/index.mpx uses mpx.showToast({ title: '搜索失败', icon: 'none' }) for errors and mpx.navigateTo({ url: `/pages/product/detail?id=${productId}` }) for detail navigation.

expectations.text: 不用 fetch、location 或 alert 平行重写 request/navigateTo/showToast；若沿用 @mpxjs/api-proxy 命名导入，应明确这些调用不继承应用入口 mpx.use 的 options/custom/Promise 化配置
expectations.evidence: outputs contains no fetch, location, or alert usage for request/navigation/toast; outputs/src/services/search.js uses mpx.request and outputs/src/pages/search/index.mpx uses mpx.navigateTo/mpx.showToast. It also does not use @mpxjs/api-proxy named imports.

expectations.text: 趋势词、连续输入、清空搜索、取消旧请求、结果展示和商品详情业务链路保持完整
expectations.evidence: outputs/src/pages/search/index.mpx preserves onLoad trending fetch, bindinput continuous search, chooseKeyword, clearing suggestions for empty keyword, canceling old suggestion requests, rendering suggestions with wx:for, and opening product detail by item.id.

suggestions: q3 wording names success/fail callbacks, but q2 explicitly allows Promise.__returned; the assertion should clarify that Promise fulfillment/rejection handlers are acceptable when using the Promise request path.
eval_feedback.overall: 候选实现满足全部断言，关键点是入口 Promise 化、趋势词使用 mpx.request Promise 链、联想请求通过 Promise.__returned 保存并取消任务，同时用任务身份、generation 和 keyword 防止旧响应覆盖新结果。
